sourceSpec.title: SWF File Format Specification Version 19, Streaming sound and Frame subdivision for streaming sound
sourceSpec.interpretationBoundary: The specification explains block SampleCount, first-block latency, and SeekSamples after a frame seek. It does not prove this page's original host playback or human listening result.

sourceClock.inference: Frame 8 candidate audible entry is inferred from first-block latency and the exact 1837-sample seek relation on frames 9-416; original-runtime entry timing is unverified.

transport.method: User-initiated AudioContext at native 22050 Hz; fetch and SHA-256 check the complete original extracted MP3; decode complete buffer once; schedule three non-overlapping AudioBufferSourceNode offsets from source block relationships. Stop nodes on pause, frame seek, Replay, glossary click, locale change, or pagehide. No encoded MP3 split or synthesized silence.
transport.browser: Chromium via playwright-cli, local loopback HTTP only
checks: Play from frame 1 fetched, hash-checked, decoded and scheduled the source MP3; visual frame advanced without application script errors.
Pause stopped the source schedule and froze visual frame 329 across two browser observations.
Play from frame 417 scheduled exactly the later two runs: source offsets 34.1534693877551 and 37.489433106575966 seconds, with scheduled starts 3.83333333333334 seconds apart.
Play from frame 987 scheduled only the final run at source offset 80.6443537414966 seconds; clicking Surface stopped the audio schedule and opened the glossary modal.
Replay during playback returned to 1/1216, stopped the audio schedule, closed the glossary modal, and incremented the replay counter to 1.
The only v5 browser console error was a missing local favicon.ico.

retainedFailure.finding: The first requestAnimationFrame after async decode could have a timestamp slightly before performance.now, producing frame 0 and GEO_L06_P002_INVALID_FRAME_IDENTITY. V5 clamps the frame to its playback start; v4 remains retained as failed evidence.
